paper.title: Learning to Explore with Lagrangians for Bandits under Unknown Linear Constraints

settings.name_in_paper: Pure exploration in bandits with unknown linear constraints (r-optimal feasible policy identification, fixed confidence)
unmapped: Goal is to identify an r-optimal policy (distribution over arms) within the feasible set {pi in simplex : A pi <= 0} defined by d unknown linear constraints
Each pull also returns a noisy cost vector A a_t + eta_t with 1-sub-Gaussian noise, used to estimate the unknown constraint matrix A
Learner knows tolerance r and confidence delta
settings.definition_quote:

umconst 	imes

symbols.T_Fr: characteristic time T_{F,r}(mu) under known constraints
symbols.s_shadow: shadow price Gamma_max/Gamma_min of the slack of the true constraints at the optimal feasible policy

conditions: mean vector in a bounded set D
true constraint matrix has non-zero slack vector (Slater-type)
reward distributions sub-Gaussian one-parameter exponential family
tuning: stopping threshold beta(t,delta) as in Theorem 7

source.label: thm:LATS upper bound
source.quote: Let $\SP$ be the shadow price ... Under Assumption~\ref{ass:structural} and~\ref{ass:distrubutional}, the expected stopping time of LATS satisfies $$\lim_{\substack{\delta\rightarrow 0}} \frac{\mathbb{E}[\tau_{\delta}]}{\log(1/\delta)} \leq \alpha T_{\cF,r}(\bmu) (1+\SP)$$ for any $\alpha>1$.

results.notes: Asymptotic expected stopping time bound; written as limsup ratio times log(1/delta). Paper writes lim.

symbols.T_Fr: characteristic time T_{F,r}(mu) under known constraints

conditions: mean vector in a bounded set D
true constraint matrix has non-zero slack vector (Slater-type)
reward distributions sub-Gaussian one-parameter exponential family
tuning: g(t) = 3 log t + log log t

source.label: thm:LAGEX upper bound
source.quote: Under Assumption~\ref{ass:structural} and~\ref{ass:distrubutional}, the expected sample complexity of LAGEX satisfies $$\lim_{\substack{\delta\rightarrow 0}} \frac{\mathbb{E}[\tau_{\delta}]}{\log(1/\delta)} \leq T_{\cF,r}(\bmu).$$

results.notes: Asymptotically optimal matching the known-constraint lower bound of Carlsson et al. Proof also gives non-asymptotic E[tau] <= T_0(delta) + 2s + CK with unspecified O-terms; not recorded.
